book.name: 1 Korinti
book.title: PAS NAMBA WAN PAULO MENI KORINTI EMARE GAENUA

content: Gera otao mamai Yerusalem nate ena bogamasa noisowa ami emo
omata dara potarise senua.
Gera otao mamai nasokai eni meni bogamasa nowera ami emo omata dara potitinonakai amira ge sane. Tuara dubu eni Galata zebura nowera ami warise sena da ago ine wewo.

Nikare omata tamamunowa awa sero gosinoise Sande sero omata agewa imata-kamata demese potiro woi wawa itaise. Ago kaka wamu nuawa na muro kei awana omata siana-katana wamu inoise bua bamu wai azu, ago wawise tona.
Na nisokare nana muro ema sianiro pumamunowa awa nukare pas gaero potitinoise iyetana duba ewanana waira nena nisokare puro bamu Yerusalem nate namunora.
Ota omata bamu wai giro na dai bayanekare.
Paulo nu nusokare nana bayamu sero be potinua.
Na Masedonia zebura baro nata temuro nisokare nana mamunona. Na gita Masedonia zebura nata temuro amire mamunona, awa giwo.
Nisokare nana muro pei-kaka nuamunonita, ota nuana ewa eraira be tepo wamunoi, awa na kaka gamu inona. Are nikare ebata naso amira na soremawa nani-nani awa na bayamunona awa.
Na zeme nisokare nana pei-kaka gege desimuro nikare giro eya doro bayai azu tona. Tua meni ninai na muro nisokare nana borere nuamu sero tona awa.
Na zeme Efeso nate dago itana pura zazo Pentekos be zora awamunoya awa.
Ena Tua meni ge tugata waira bua wana me kei awaise ebata garata asai zo tami bua naso bamu kei awinoya. Ata gera iwo witai nora.
Timoti meni nisokare nana kei awai otao wawa azure oko nuaise. Na Tuara bua inowena da ago nu inowia awa.
Are nisokare nana zo meni numore gai oko osaise. Nu korawero iyetawa ewanana ewesemuro naso nana mae. Nu ata gera otao eni mara gamu itena.
Gera otao nasokai Apolo nu gera otao enire dai nisokare nana maise sero be izinona, ata peu kaka wamu inoya. Nu be zeme emire kota, ama be zore kotumai te wai giro amire nisokare nana mamunoya awa.
Tepo waira ge
Nikare uma wero baitiro tuma diai amira zewai wero dopewo. Ago inoise burau tepo pugeu wero noiwo.
Ata bua bamubamu awa dago dubara dumire dai wewo.

Otao mamai naso, ge zo nimorekare sana niniu. Nikare Stefana awisorera ge ninitinowewa awa. Nukare Akaya zebura ena gita wero ge niniwa. Ata nukare ge ema nisokare nana sou bua waira peu wero inowera, awa gosinowewa.
Are ina nikare nukare ata eni ge emo inoise numorekare dai bua inowera, nukare awa giwo giti kopi nisokare ware.
Stefana ata Fotunato ata Akaiko nukare naso nana kei awetera na duba naso ewanana wataya. Nera kota, na nikare kau inoise itena nukare muro nikare ine wero
duba naso ata duba nisokare kora wetera ewanana wataya. Nikare ema ago ine amire giwo ewanana ware.
Tuara dubu Asia zebura nowera ami nikare arenitinora. Akuilato Prisikare ata Tuara dubu so nusotora ena aunitinowera ami Tua emo wero nimorekare yawa sara inoise nikare arenitinora.
Gera otao mamai dapikarago meni nikare arenitinora. Nikare nitopekare Tua emo inoise wana ina-zia wewo.
Na Paulo, na natope nikare arenitinoise zazo naso gainona.
Zo nu duba nuso Tuara nana kaka itamu ami degara gegenai waise. O Tua nasokare, muyo.
Tua Yesura dumi yagaba meni nisokare nana itaise.
Dubara dumi naso meni Kristo Yesu emo wero nisokare nana te itia.
